cats.name: Oliver
cats.bio: Oliver is a sweet, affectionate orange tabby who loves lounging on warm cushions and chasing laser pointers. He gets along wonderfully with people and loves chin scratches.

cats.name: Snowball
cats.bio: Snowball is a fluffy, regal Persian beauty with ocean-blue eyes. She thrives in calm environments, enjoys soft grooming sessions, and loves being pampered.

cats.name: Cleo
cats.bio: Cleo is a curious and energetic Calico explorer. She loves windowsill bird-watching, climbing cat trees, and making cute chirping sounds when excited.

cats.name: Shadow
cats.bio: Shadow is a sleek black panther cat with glowing amber eyes. He is extremely loyal, loves lap cuddles during movie nights, and gets along great with other pets.
